comment: Frozen known-good baseline for eval/regression_gate.py. Measured 2026-11-17 on the real models (bge-small-en-v1.5 + ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2) over the 35-question golden set, in the build sandbox; CI runners differ, so latency carries the headroom factor. Regenerated after the per-stage latency fix (stage spans are now billed/recorded after close; rerank dominates at ~1.86 s mean). Update deliberately, in its own commit, when a change is intended to move these numbers.
